title: Book Three · Chapter 39: Ten Fifty at the Green Door
story:
By ten on Saturday, Ronan is alone in the family's rooms.

Dad left for work early. Mum left at a quarter to ten with the coat. Ronan keeps the receipt on the table and the yard gate open.

He sits near the window. From there, he can hear a cart outside.

At the field, Anna's friend will be near the end of her own race. Kai said he would watch. Ronan looks at the clock, then at his school book.

He reads one line three times.

At twenty past ten, Mr Qiu comes to the gate.

“No school today?”

“Running day. I'm waiting for the rice.”

“Ah. Your mother told me.”

Mr Qiu looks at the empty place by the kitchen wall.

“When does the run start?”

“Eleven.”

“You still have time.”

Ronan nods. A woman calls from the stall. Mr Qiu turns back and opens another box of pencils for her. Two children wait beside the woman.

At half past ten, he closes the school book. He gets up and walks into the yard.

Anna may be waiting near the track now. He pictures her coat across her knees, then remembers she will be in her running clothes.

The old bell is warm from the sun. He keeps his hands away from it.

At a quarter to eleven, a cart stops outside.

Ronan goes to the gate. The man from the shop stands beside one large rice bag.

“Here?” he asks.

“Yes. By the kitchen wall, please.”

The man lifts the bag onto his shoulder. Ronan walks ahead and holds the inner door open. The man carries it in and lowers it into the dry space.

Ronan checks the bag. It is whole, with no rice loose on the floor. He shows the receipt.

“Paid,” the man says. He nods and goes back to his cart.

Ronan closes the family's door and takes his key. He picks up the bottle, wheels the blue bike outside, and shuts the yard gate behind him.

It is ten fifty when he leaves.

On the quiet street, he rides steadily. At the busy corner, he gets off. A cart blocks part of the crossing. He waits, then pushes the bike past it.

Beyond the corner, he rides again. His shirt moves against his back. He can hear the old bell shake softly over the rough ground.

The school gate is open. The clock above the entrance shows five past eleven.

A whistle sounds from the field.

Ronan pushes his bike inside and leaves it beside the other bikes. Then he walks quickly toward the track.

Near the bench, Kai sees him and lifts an arm. Anna is not beside him.

Ronan turns toward the runners on the far curve.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

receipt＝收据；quarter to eleven＝十点四十五分；whole＝完整的、没有破损的；five past eleven＝十一点零五分。

## 理解问题

1. 米几点送到、由谁搬进屋？Ronan什么时候离家？
2. 他在忙路口怎样通行？到学校时，十一点的长跑有没有开始？

## 读句子

**The man carries it in and lowers it into the dry space.**

拆开看：The man / carries it in / and lowers it into the dry space.

送货的人／把米袋搬进来／放进干燥的位置。
